about_the_game:
"River and Mountain Looking North"

In this blockbuster live-action interactive game, you become the second prince of the Xuan Kingdom, a power that has migrated south. Faced with the Wu Nu entrenched in the north and the imperial court reeling in internal turmoil, you are determined to conquer your homeland and reclaim China.

While there may be countless ways to achieve this, one thing remains constant: in these turbulent times, the Northern Expedition is a slogan, a banner, the will of the people, and... a ladder to heaven!

Rest with the people, make friends with distant nations, attack those near, and change ancestral systems. Every decision you make will be revealed in real time through immersive live-action film footage, profoundly impacting the process of reclaiming your homeland. Power struggles, human desires, and the grudges of family and country intertwine as you write this magnificent imperial epic. Will you turn the tide and reclaim your homeland? Will success or failure be the outcome, leaving a legacy of eternal regret? You'll be the one to write it!

Features:

1. Cinematic Live-Action Immersion, Every Frame a Historical Scene

As the core highlight of a live-action interactive game, "River and Mountain North" employs cinematic production standards to create an immersive narrative experience. All key plot points, character interactions, and scene transitions are presented through real-life footage.

2. Thousands of Decisions Affect the Entire Game, with a Dynamic Storyline Never Repeated

The core gameplay of the game is "Choices Affect the Outcome." Every player choice impacts the game's progression, forming a unique storyline.

3. Intrigue and Emotion Intertwine, Character Relationships Determine Success or Failure

Set within the grand narrative of the Northern Expedition, "River and Mountain North" deeply depicts the relationships between characters in turbulent times. As the second prince of the Xuan Kingdom, players must not only navigate the open and covert attacks but also manage the emotional connections with key figures.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains some nudity or sexual content, as well as sensitive content such as alcohol abuse, and may not be suitable for all ages.
